## Findings

- [ ] **[Repo/FAIL] About sidebar has no description**
  - **Status quo:** `gh repo view` reports `description: ""` on a public repo. The About
    sidebar renders empty and search/social snippets have no summary line.
  - **Proposed solution:** Set a one-sentence description (≤ 120 chars) naming what the
    site is and for whom, e.g. `gh repo edit --description "Public website for the Symaira
    local-first AI tool ecosystem."`.
  - **Effort/Impact:** Low effort / medium impact.

- [ ] **[Security/FAIL] Secret scanning disabled on public repo**
  - **Status quo:** `security_and_analysis` reports `secret_scanning: disabled`,
    `secret_scanning_push_protection: disabled` on a public repo. Committed secrets are
    not detected, and push protection cannot block them.
  - **Proposed solution:** Enable secret scanning + push protection in the repo Security
    settings (free for public repos). Enabling is an owner action; code-scanning default
    setup (`state: not-configured`) and Dependabot security updates (`disabled`) should be
    enabled in the same pass.
  - **Effort/Impact:** Low effort / high impact.

- [ ] **[CI/FAIL] No workflow runs on pull_request — PRs merge without CI**
  - **Status quo:** `.github/workflows/` contains only `deploy.yml` (push to main +
    workflow_dispatch). `git log --all -- .github/workflows/` shows deploy.yml is the only
    workflow ever committed. Commit ba2e77d claims a "fast PR gate — lint + ubuntu tests on
    PRs" but no such workflow exists; branch protection has `required_status_checks: null`.
  - **Proposed solution:** Add `.github/workflows/ci.yml` with a `pull_request` trigger
    running `npm ci && npm run lint && npm run build` (fast gate), then require the check
    on `main` branch protection (follow-up issue).
  - **Effort/Impact:** Low effort / high impact.

- [ ] **[Security/WARN] Deploy uses plaintext FTP**
  - **Status quo:** `deploy.yml` uses `protocol: ftp` on port 21; `FTP_PASSWORD` is
    transmitted in cleartext on every deploy. History shows an earlier "Use FTPS for
    deployment" commit that is no longer present.
  - **Proposed solution:** Switch to `protocol: ftps` (All-Inkl supports FTPS) and verify
    one real deploy end-to-end before merging. Also add a least-privilege
    `permissions: { contents: read }` block to the workflow.
  - **Effort/Impact:** Low effort / high impact.

- [ ] **[Protection/WARN] main merges without required status checks**
  - **Status quo:** `required_status_checks: null` and `required_conversation_resolution:
    false` on `main`. Any PR (or direct push, since `enforce_admins: false`) can merge with
    zero CI verification. Approval count 0 is correct for this solo repo; the missing piece
    is the CI gate.
  - **Proposed solution:** After the PR CI workflow exists, add its check as a required
    status check and enable conversation resolution on `main` branch protection.
  - **Effort/Impact:** Low effort / high impact.

- [ ] **[Security/WARN] Dependabot version updates not configured**
  - **Status quo:** `.github/dependabot.yml` missing. Detected ecosystems: `npm`
    (package.json) and `github-actions` (.github/workflows/). `dependabot_security_updates`
    is disabled.
  - **Proposed solution:** Create `.github/dependabot.yml` with weekly schedules for npm
    and github-actions, group minor/patch updates, and enable security updates in settings.
  - **Effort/Impact:** Low effort / medium impact.

- [ ] **[Community/WARN] Community health profile 28/100 — core files missing**
  - **Status quo:** `community/profile` reports health_percentage 28. Missing:
    SECURITY.md, CONTRIBUTING.md, CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md, issue templates, PR template,
    repository description.
  - **Proposed solution:** Add `.github/SECURITY.md` (supported versions + reporting
    flow), `.github/CONTRIBUTING.md`, `.github/CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md`, one `.yml` issue form
    (bug + feature), and a PR template.
  - **Effort/Impact:** Low effort / medium impact.

- [ ] **[Community/WARN] README is a stub**
  - **Status quo:** `README.md` is 43 lines, no tagline under the H1, no badges, no
    "Why"/comparison section beyond the brief product-model list.
  - **Proposed solution:** Add a one-line tagline, CI/license badges, and a short "Why
    Symaira" section; keep the existing honest "Ecosystem Rule".
  - **Effort/Impact:** Low effort / low impact.

- [ ] **[Repo/WARN] No repository topics**
  - **Status quo:** `repositoryTopics: null` on a public repo — zero discoverability via
    `github.com/topics/`.
  - **Proposed solution:** Add ≥ 3 topics, e.g. `react`, `typescript`, `vite`,
    `local-first`, `ai-agents`.
  - **Effort/Impact:** Low effort / low impact.

- [ ] **[Repo/WARN] All three merge methods enabled, no policy**
  - **Status quo:** `mergeCommitAllowed`, `squashMergeAllowed`, `rebaseMergeAllowed` all
    true; history uses squash merges (PRs #6-#9).
  - **Proposed solution:** Keep squash-merge only (matches PR history) and disable merge
    commit + rebase in repo settings.
  - **Effort/Impact:** Low effort / low impact.

- [ ] **[Repo/WARN] LICENSE is a custom "Other" text**
  - **Status quo:** `licenseInfo: Other / NOASSERTION`. The LICENSE file is a custom
    796-byte text, not an SPDX-recognized license.
  - **Proposed solution:** If the intent is a known license (e.g. AGPL-3.0/MIT), replace
    the file with the canonical text; otherwise leave as-is and accept the "Other" badge.
    Decision is the owner's.
  - **Effort/Impact:** Low effort / low impact.

- [ ] **[Labels/WARN] Priority label set incomplete**
  - **Status quo:** Only `priority: medium` exists; `priority: urgent`, `priority: high`,
    `priority: low` are missing (the 02-gh-plan conventions write all four).
  - **Proposed solution:** `gh label create priority:urgent --color B60205`,
    `priority:high --color D93F0B`, `priority:low --color 0E8A16` with descriptions.
  - **Effort/Impact:** Low effort / low impact.

- [ ] **[Labels/WARN] 'enhancement' duplicates 'feature'**
  - **Status quo:** Both `enhancement` (GitHub default) and `feature` (workflow convention)
    exist with overlapping semantics; issues will be inconsistently labeled.
  - **Proposed solution:** Retire `enhancement` and standardize on `feature`.
  - **Effort/Impact:** Low effort / low impact.

- [ ] **[Labels/WARN] No Projects v2 board titled "symaira.com"**
  - **Status quo:** `gh project list --owner danieljustus` shows 19 boards, none titled
    `symaira.com` (the guard-gh convention). Tracking currently happens via
    `group:*`/`cycle:current` labels.
  - **Proposed solution:** Either accept labels-only tracking (document it) or create a
    `symaira.com` project with Status/Priority fields.
  - **Effort/Impact:** Medium effort / low impact.

- [ ] **[Security/WARN] Code scanning not configured; private vulnerability reporting not enabled**
  - **Status quo:** `code-scanning/default-setup` state `not-configured`, no CodeQL
    workflow. `private_vulnerability_reporting` absent from `security_and_analysis`
    response. Dependabot alert API returns 403 (alerts disabled).
  - **Proposed solution:** Enable default code-scanning setup (JS/TS, weekly) and private
    vulnerability reporting in repo settings; add SECURITY.md so reporters land on a
    policy.
  - **Effort/Impact:** Low effort / medium impact.

## Conclusion

Top three fixes by impact: (1) enable secret scanning + push protection on the public
repo, (2) add a pull_request CI workflow and require it on `main`, (3) switch the deploy
to FTPS so credentials stop crossing the network in cleartext. All are low-effort, owner
or one-file changes; none requires a release.
